description: Price a buy or sell from the token's live on-chain bonding curve, including the 1% fee, price impact and minimum output. Sends nothing. If partialFill is true, the buy would complete the curve and solCharged is what would actually be spent.

amount.description: Positive integer as a string. buy: SOL in lamports (1 SOL = 1000000000). sell: raw token units (6 decimals, 1 token = 1000000)

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points, up to 500 (5%). Default 100 (1%). A sandwich bot can take up to the whole tolerance, so keep it tight
